title: The chain item being passed on is Herald of the Arcane's activated ability ('[1], [Exhaust]: Play a 1 [Might] Recruit unit token'), which the engine allowed player-1 to activate (step 32) while a non-combat Showdown was open at the battlefield (Showdown Open state), and it now sits on the chain awaiting resolution.
expected: activate-ability.ts:39-50 `abilityTimingClass` returns "action" for any non-gear activated ability lacking an Action/Reaction keyword (line 49: `getCardType(hostCardId) === "gear" ? "standard" : "action"`). isLegalTiming("action", "showdown-open") is true (chain/chain-state.ts:208), so the condition at activate-ability.ts:514-517 passes. Herald of the Arcane (riftbound-cards/src/cards/ogn/herald-of-the-arcane.ts) declares its ability with no keyword/timing, so it is treated as Action-speed. Trace step 31 shows showdown active + chain null (showdown-open) with activateAbility offered; step 32 puts chain-2 (create-token) on the chain. Rules 310.1.a and the showdown rules ("Only cards and abilities with the Action or Reaction keywords can be played or activated in a Showdown State"; "Card abilities, by default, cannot be played during a Showdown State") say an untagged legend ability is Neutral-Open only. Engine bug confirmed.
